title: Tuna Pasta Bake

extendedIngredients.name: tuna in olive oil
extendedIngredients.original: 425 g tin tuna in olive oil, drained

steps: Set the oven to 190°C (180°C fan-forced). Rub a large baking dish with a little oil.
Cook the penne in a large pot of salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat a splash of olive oil in a large deep frying pan over medium heat. Cook the brown onion for 3-4 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and dried Italian herbs. Simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens, then season with salt and pepper.
Stir the frozen peas through the sauce, then gently fold in the drained tuna, keeping the chunks intact.
Toss the drained penne through the sauce until well coated, then tip everything into the baking dish.
Scatter the shredded mozzarella over the top and bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Scatter over the torn basil leaves and serve straight from the dish.
